grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression well: it kept the thin-reflection turn short, gave a grounded three-item recap, and confirmed the lock in one line. The main misses are a next-step text that omits the 20-minute length and a middle-of-text question that makes ZOH's reply run four sentences.
